convertibility_reason: Uses custom signal filter CH_HM_CCI from external .mqh library (ACH_HM_CCI.mqh). The trading logic depends on a custom indicator/signal class that is not a built-in MT5 indicator, requiring inspection and manual translation of the custom signal class.

other_exits: Signal threshold close at 20 - opposite signal strength below threshold triggers close

custom_logic_notes: Uses MQL5 Standard Library CExpert framework. Signal logic is encapsulated in CH_HM_CCI custom filter class from ACH_HM_CCI.mqh - the exact entry/exit conditions (CCI vs MA crossover or threshold logic) require reading that .mqh file. Expert_EveryTick=false means signal evaluation happens once per bar, not every tick. Signal_ThresholdOpen=40 and Signal_ThresholdClose=20 are the voting weights - the CExpertSignal framework uses weighted voting across filters; a single filter with weight 1.0 needs threshold>=40 to open and signal falls below 20 to close. Expiration=4 bars for any pending orders.
python_conversion_notes: Must read ACH_HM_CCI.mqh to extract the actual CCI+MA signal logic. The CExpert framework's weighted voting system (ThresholdOpen=40, ThresholdClose=20 with Weight=1.0) needs to be simplified: with a single filter at weight 1.0, opening requires the filter's LongCondition/ShortCondition to return >=40, and closing requires the opposite condition to return >=20. SL/TP are both 0 meaning no fixed stop - exits are purely signal-driven. The MoneyFixedLot class uses a fixed lot size of 0.1 with a 10% margin percent parameter for validation. TrailingNone means no trailing stop implementation needed.
